svg.title: Two independent patterns of strain
svg.desc: Two test-particle rings are distorted into ellipses along axes separated by forty-five degrees. The figure shows a local detector-frame interpretation at one phase, to first order in strain. Real astrophysical strains at Earth are vastly smaller; the interactive figure lets you move through a cycle.

g.text: Axes stretch and squeeze in alternation.
Reference ring: gray. One exaggerated wave phase: colored. Propagation is perpendicular to the page.
